_doc: Apify scrapers the session may run through mcp__Apify__call-actor, checked by .claude/hooks/apify_gate.py. input_keys come from each actor's input schema (fetch-actor-details, 27 Oct 2026): Apify silently ignores a misspelled key, so the gate refuses unknown keys. null = keys not checked yet. All of these bill per event, so callOptions.maxItems does nothing; every call must set callOptions.maxTotalChargeUsd at or under max_charge_usd. fixed: keys that must be sent with exactly this value; forbid: keys that must be absent, false or 0 (personal-data add-ons). Add or raise an actor only with the owner's OK.

apify/instagram-scraper.use: outlier mining and competitor posts (ORGANIC-OS 5.1, growth-engine step 1)

apify/instagram-reel-scraper.use: one reel's details and transcript (refbank capture, motion-studio/HANDOFF.md 7.4)

apify/instagram-hashtag-scraper.use: reels for a hashtag or keyword (refbank scouting)

apify/facebook-posts-scraper.use: a prospect's or competitor's Facebook page posts (pre-meeting audit)

compass/crawler-google-places.use: a prospect's Google Maps listing and local competitors (pre-meeting audit)

apify/facebook-ads-scraper.use: Ad Library pages for competitor ads

seemuapps/video-frame-extractor.use: frames from a public reference reel (refbank)
